ios.desc:
Kurozu helps you build a local-first timeline of health context specifically for enhancing communication with AI.

Start locally without an account. Add facts with precise, approximate, or timeless dates. When you choose to sign in, cloud timelines can sync through your account.

Optional Apple Health preview features read selected Health data on device to generate temporary local-only summaries based on timeline facts.

Export feature builds an AI-facing prompt in plain text so you can paste your context wherever you choose.

Optional AI on cloud timelines with Kurozu Premium:
- Ask and research with AI
- Have AI suggest facts to add to timeline based on research
- Use AI to add facts

Kurozu is for personal information management. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/.

quotes.text:
Working on a mobile app for making reusable AI-ready health context

- Simply a timeline of events/facts
- Events are natural language, with fuzzy dates
- Simple Apple Health insight extraction
- Export as prompt
- Local first, no account required

The thinking is that, for most health queries to AI I want my personal health context to be part of the input. And don't want to rewrite every time.

Curious whether this approach makes sense to other people.
Try the app and share your thoughts!
